Pushkar Mela Concludes with Kartik Purnima Celebrations

The Pushkar Mela concluded on Kartik Purnima with a final holy bath, drawing approximately two lakh devotees. The event also featured a camel named 'Badal' from Sikar, whose Usta art shaving, costing 20,000 rupees, and dance performances to Marwari songs attracted tourists. The Usta art on the camel was the result of 72 hours of work.
